product_one_liner.value: Neostella provides a connected legal case-management platform that unifies cases, documents, workflows, communications, reporting, and AI for growing and enterprise legal teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The platform page directly describes the connected capabilities and identifies growing and enterprise legal teams as the audience: https://neostella.com/platform.

pricing_page.notes: Neostella has a public legal case-management pricing page: https://neostella.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The pricing page includes customer testimonials attributed to representatives of both law firms: https://neostella.com/pricing. | named_customers.0: A customer testimonial identifies Donna Salao of KRA Legal: https://neostella.com/pricing. | named_customers.1: A customer testimonial identifies Donna Law Marston of Aylstock, Witkin, Kreis & Overholtz: https://neostella.com/pricing.

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/11312411.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies Milwaukee as headquarters, consistent with Neostella's own location information: https://linkedin.com/company/11312411 and https://neostella.com/about-us. | hq_country: The company page places Milwaukee in the USA, and its company profile identifies Milwaukee as headquarters: https://neostella.com/about-us and https://linkedin.com/company/11312411.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2019: https://neostella.com/about-us.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index shows legal-workflow advice, law-firm technology commentary, and a company-story article, rather than two engineer-authored posts about building the product: https://neostella.com/resources/blogs.

public_docs.notes: The public support center contains multiple substantive articles, including integration guidance and release documentation, and links to a dedicated API documentation portal: https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/43136719410711-Integrations-Quick-Guide and https://api.neostella.app/docs/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live application page advertises a Machine Learning Engineer position developing production AI and ML capabilities: https://apply.workable.com/neostella/j/CC2AB7C2DF.

model_provider.notes: The March 2026 release notes state that OpenAI credentials are automatically configured during tenant provisioning to activate AI features: https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/38853128362903-march-2026-release-notes.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and GDPR under Compliance without an in-progress qualifier. These are public compliance claims, not an independent assessment of certification: http://trust.neostella.com/. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 Type II is named under Compliance: http://trust.neostella.com/. | compliance_certs.1: HIPAA is named under Compliance: http://trust.neostella.com/. | compliance_certs.2: GDPR is named under Compliance: http://trust.neostella.com/.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile classifies the latest $10.7 million round as Series B. Confidence is reduced because another funding directory uses the less-specific label 'Venture - Series Unknown': https://tracxn.com/d/companies/neostella/__fars07A8H78z111eNnkuxG-0hzNIjYBRtoysJ9gBlsY. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the round May 23, 2025, matching the SEC filing's date of first sale. The answer uses the sale month rather than the June filing month: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2071719/000207171925000001/xslFormDX01/primary_doc.xml. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile records $10.7 million for the latest round, corroborated by the June 6, 2025 filing reporting $10.7 million sold. This is the amount raised, not the $15 million offering target: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/neostella/__fars07A8H78z111eNnkuxG-0hzNIjYBRtoysJ9gBlsY and https://www.formds.com/issuers/neostella-inc.

raised_18mo.notes: The SEC filing records a first sale on May 23, 2025, and the filing index reports $10.7 million sold. That date falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2071719/000207171925000001/xslFormDX01/primary_doc.xml and https://www.formds.com/issuers/neostella-inc.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The verified current-openings page lists an Account Executive position: https://apply.workable.com/neostella/j/F0412E13E7.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 2026 release introduced Full Sandboxes that replicate production schema and operational data for safe testing—a substantive platform capability rather than a bug fix or cosmetic change. September falls within the requested six-month window: https://help.neostella.com/hc/en-us/articles/43157163401367-september-2026-release-notes.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Mayer's dated profile lists his VP of Product role beginning in December 2025, following a Director of Product role. This supports a VP-level appointment within the window, specifically an internal promotion rather than a new company hire: https://linkedin.com/in/bammke.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A sales job posting explicitly requires using Salesforce CRM, while the subprocessor list names Salesforce for sales automation and HubSpot for CRM, marketing, and sales automation: https://builtin.com/job/business-development-representative/10241584 and http://trust.neostella.com/subprocessors. | crm_stack_signal.0: The sales job description explicitly instructs employees to manage their work in Salesforce CRM: https://builtin.com/job/business-development-representative/10241584. | crm_stack_signal.1: The subprocessor list names HubSpot for CRM, marketing, and sales automation: http://trust.neostella.com/subprocessors.
